label: late original-phase tokens and the <DEL> step (end of input)
explanation: Fires only during the input part of the sequence: original tokens from about position 3 onward, plus the <DEL> step. It never fires in the copy phase and never at t=0-1. Firing rate goes up with position (orig_idx 3: 13%, 8: 77%) and with L, and is 45% at <DEL>. Top activations reach max on the last one or two original tokens before <DEL> (often d/r), with <DEL> at about 0.6 of max. Firing is stronger on first occurrences of a token (in_first: 22% vs 3.5%), on input tokens d,r,m,a,b,l,s, and when the sequence contains tokens like e,t,3,c,u,v,1,q (higher rate when one of these is the first token). These modulate firing but do not make a clean predicate (token-set and seen() refinements stay at F1 of about 0.60-0.64). The position-only predicate captures about 86% of activation mass, but precision is only about 0.53.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (input phase: d, r, m, a; delimiter step: <DEL>; copy phase: ) and the first original token (most: e, t, 3, c, v, u; least: a, r, b, d); timing cues that raise it most: t=7, t=6, t=5.
